verdict.rationale: Supabase ships its own background automation primitives. Supabase Cron schedules recurring jobs with cron syntax and monitors their runs, Database Webhooks fire automatically on table events, and Queues provide durable guaranteed-delivery messaging. Together these let users set up recurring and event-driven automations that run unattended inside the platform. missing for 10: documented AI-agent-driven autonomous workflows (the agent tooling covers interactive querying and deployment, not unattended agent loops), independent or hands-on corroboration that scheduled or background jobs run reliably.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Supabase Cron is a Postgres Module that simplifies scheduling recurring Jobs with cron syntax and monitoring Job runs inside Postgres.
Database Webhooks allow you to send real-time data from your database to another system whenever a table event occurs.
Supabase Queues is a Postgres-native durable Message Queue system with guaranteed delivery built on the pgmq database extension.
